alternatives_rejected.why: Inbound p50 rose only 1.16x and own self-time only 1.06x (E2). Uniform delay would shift the median, not mainly cause caller-observed errors (0->0.1093, E2). The extreme p90 tail with a modest p50 (E1) fits retransmit/timeout behavior from loss.

The socket deviation (z=24.36, E1) is far smaller than the latency deviation. It fits connections piling up during retransmits/timeouts. The service still logs normal INFO request handling with no error logs (E3), so it is not refusing connections.
The mem deviation (z=19.48, E1) is modest. Own span self-time is unchanged at 0.19->0.2ms (E2), so compute is not degraded. This is likely a secondary effect of buffered or pending requests.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect and remove the network fault on the emailservice pod or interface, for example a tc netem loss rule or a faulty sidecar or network policy. Verify that caller-side error rate and p90 latency return to baseline. Restart the pod or reschedule it to a healthy node only if the loss persists.
